activity_summary: You said the twenty-two did not pay the fifty or the eight. You stopped. You did not go out again, and you did not send the letter.

entities.name: the Princess's gown
entities.context: Mentioned in Not against the fifty

facets.activity: Repeated the twenty-two shillings and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twenty-two, and the page stays unpaid.
